title: Fix duplicate PC-sharing helpers and silent pairing failures
summary: Prevent a second helper from replacing VNC credentials while an existing helper owns the screen-sharing port; show pairing progress and actionable errors.

changes.detail: Check loopback VNC port before changing credentials or starting another helper.
Show connection progress, hide the phone keyboard on submit, and report missing session cookies and VNC authentication failure.

validation.name: Live diagnosis
validation.detail: Two app-owned helpers and two UltraVNC processes found. Protocol check accepted pairing but rejected VNC authentication.

validation.name: Correction checks
validation.detail: Pending controlled helper restart and protocol tests.
